competitors.name: congress_mirror
competitors.rules: Mirrors members of Congress from the kadoa STOCK Act disclosure mirror: follows every filer with a real track record and buys the in-universe names they disclosed purchasing within 120 days, weighting each name by how many distinct members bought it (consensus = conviction). Traded on the disclosure date — weeks after their actual fill.

regime.note: SPY rose 1.05% on September 3. The September 2 Beige Book describes modest economic growth and mixed sector conditions. Maintain selective biotech, gold, software and bank exposures with 40% cash; do not infer a rate decision from this qualitative report.

analyst.thesis: September 3 added one settled session: NEM +4.21%, CRM +2.92%, BAC +0.70%, VRTX +0.22%, versus SPY +1.05%. Hold VRTX 20%, NEM 16%, CRM 12%, BAC 12%, cash 40%: no verified thesis break. Add the September 14 BAC conference as a company-specific checkpoint before the September 16 FOMC; CRM has September 9 and 16 investor events. VRTX retains its November 30 FDA decision after the completed acquisition. Red Chris remains a later-2026 decision with no exact date, so NEM is a smaller timing-constrained sleeve. SNOW, HOOD, COIN, MRNA and DE were investigated after the randomized screen; their sharp realized moves or valuation did not establish a better anticipatory entry. This is the project paper-portfolio bridge, not an official plugin investment recommendation.

evidence.point: Vertex said it completed the Crinetics acquisition on September 1, 2026; the transaction had an approximately $10.0 billion equity value, and Vertex scheduled its third-quarter earnings call for November 2, 2026.
Vertex reported Q2 2026 revenue of $3.33 billion, up 12%, raised full-year revenue guidance to $13.1-$13.2 billion, and lists a November 30, 2026 povetacicept PDUFA date.
Newmont said Red Chris received major regulatory approvals and is progressing toward a final investment decision later in 2026.
Salesforce Q2 FY27 reported revenue of $11.3 billion, up 11%, cRPO of $33.5 billion, up 14% in constant currency, and free cash flow of $1.1 billion, up 81%.
Salesforce scheduled its Dreamforce Investor & Analyst Session for September 16, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. ET to discuss innovation and its financial framework.
The Federal Reserve calendar lists a two-day FOMC meeting for September 15–16, 2026, with a September 16 press conference.
VRTX: Robinhood P/E 32.461239, P/B 6.981360; September 3 close 557.96.
NEM: Robinhood P/E 16.469890, P/B 3.919230; September 3 close 130.43.
CRM: Robinhood P/E 24.100437, P/B 5.670590; September 3 close 264.43.
BAC: Robinhood P/E 14.507963, P/B 1.602380; September 3 close 63.04.
Bank of America investor events lists Sep 14, 2026 1:00 pm ET, Barclays Global Financial Services Conference.
Snowflake FY2027 product revenue guidance: $6,070 million, 36% growth, versus previous $5,840 million.

risks: VRTX carries a valuation premium and a roughly 60-tick binary regulatory horizon, plus acquisition integration risk.
NEM has no exact FID date and has risen 23.71% in 20 sessions; gold reversals or cost overruns can erase gains.
CRM RSI 81.88 and 41.58% 20-session appreciation make further purchases vulnerable to chasing.
BAC credit and funding commentary could disappoint; the FOMC outcome is unknown.
Forty percent cash creates opportunity cost in strong rallies. Independently measured consensus and positioning are unavailable, so variant expectations are assumptions.

rationale.VRTX: [DATA] November 30, 2026 povetacicept PDUFA (about 60 trading ticks away); Q2 revenue $3.33B, up 12%, and full-year guidance $13.1–13.2B (Vertex IR). P/E 32.461239 versus REGN 20.845412 and AMGN 27.588520 (Robinhood). [ASSUMED] The baseline is continued CF-led growth; no verified approval probability or consensus is available. My variant thesis is that renal and acquired endocrine assets can diversify earnings faster than investors expect, but that mispricing is unproven. Keep the 20% anchor, not an add after the rally. Cut conviction on regulatory delay, weak launch uptake or integration problems. [DATA] Buy limit $563.54, approximately 1% above September 3 close.
rationale.NEM: [DATA] Red Chris approvals precede a final investment decision later in 2026; no exact date is announced (Newmont IR), so the horizon is approximately 1–80 ticks. P/E 16.469890; 20-session return 23.71% (Robinhood/snapshot). FCX P/E 35.828560 is only a directional mining comparison because copper/gold exposure differs; GOLD is excluded as an unverified identity peer. [ASSUMED] The baseline is continued feasibility spending; a well-funded project decision could reduce uncertainty more than priced. No measured consensus or positioning data supports that inference. Retain 16%; cap timing uncertainty and gold/real-yield risk. Cost escalation or a postponed decision would weaken the thesis. [DATA] Buy limit $131.73, approximately 1% above September 3 close.
rationale.CRM: [DATA] September 9 investor conference (~3 ticks after today), September 16 Dreamforce investor session (~8 ticks); Q2 revenue $11.3B and cRPO $33.5B, +14% (Salesforce IR). P/E 24.100437 versus ADBE 16.343608 and ORCL 26.429209; RSI 81.88 (Robinhood/snapshot). [ASSUMED] The baseline is execution against management guidance, not independently verified sell-side consensus. The variant is that product adoption and the financial framework demonstrate durable AI monetization; the 41.58% 20-session rally argues much is already priced. Retain only 12%, with no chase; cut on weak adoption or financial-framework deterioration. [DATA] Buy limit $267.07, approximately 1% above September 3 close.
rationale.BAC: [DATA] September 14 Barclays conference (~6 ticks after today) precedes September 15–16 FOMC. P/E 14.507963 and P/B 1.602380 versus JPM 15.510431/2.722110 and MS 17.545490/3.202740 (Robinhood); MS has a different business mix. [ASSUMED] Baseline is modest activity with rate uncertainty; my variant is stable funding and credit commentary despite that uncertainty. No sourced consensus or positioning measure is available. Keep the smaller 12% sleeve; worsening credit or deposit-cost guidance invalidates the variant. [DATA] Buy limit $63.67, approximately 1% above September 3 close.

reflection.looking_back: The prior recorded book was -10.6% versus SPY +2.0%, alpha -12.6 points. The last recorded tick delivered +0.7 points of alpha; annualized 30-session Sharpe was -2.75 (analyst_memory). Fresh September 3 marks lift book equity to $90.39 before this execution. These marks are distinct from the prior recorded performance statistics.
worked: The prior tick beat SPY by 0.7 points. NEM and CRM subsequently rose 4.21% and 2.92% on September 3.
missed: All-time alpha remains -12.6 points and Sharpe -2.75; a short relative win does not validate the process.
Newmont has a window, not a dated decision, and direct consensus/positioning evidence remains missing.
reflection.adjustment: Hold targets; update buy limits, add the dated BAC September 14 company checkpoint, and explicitly downgrade unsupported consensus and timing claims to assumptions.

swarm.note: Live swarm — 150 fish, each a unique trader profile shown its own random ~20-name slice of the watchlist (with recent headlines), voted via OpenRouter. Independent-voter election; dissenters (ringed) chose CASH.

live.note: Real money — the Agentic cash account (••••), funded ~$100 on 2026-06-29, running the funded algorithms (100% momentum_breakout) via run-robin with a per-order confirm gate. Figures here are the real, unscaled account.

rules.momentum_breakout: Buy a 20-day-high breakout confirmed by above-average volume; exit when price closes below its 20-day SMA. Few big winners, many small losers.
rules.mean_reversion: Buy when RSI(14) < 30 (oversold); sell when RSI(14) > 70 (overbought). Trades less, wins more often, smaller edge.
rules.blended_momo_rsi: Momentum breakout, but skip entries already overbought (RSI ≥ 70); exit on trend break or RSI > 75. Avoids chasing extended moves.
rules.deep_research_analyst: Holds the analyst's target weights; rebalanced each tick from a fresh research report (web + Robinhood data).
rules.llm_voters: Allocates across the swarm's top vote-getters (weight ∝ vote share, capped at 60%); rebalanced each tick.
rules.mirofish_real: Real-MiroFish: persona agents with memory interact over rounds, each ranking its best ideas; the panel's rank-weighted consensus (top 5 names, weight ∝ Borda points) rebalanced each tick.
rules.congress_mirror: Mirrors members of Congress from the kadoa STOCK Act disclosure mirror: follows every filer with a real track record and buys the in-universe names they disclosed purchasing within 120 days, weighting each name by how many distinct members bought it (consensus = conviction). Traded on the disclosure date — weeks after their actual fill.

sources.name: Standings, curves, decision trail (LIVE)
sources.detail: The forward paper test — every competitor trades a $100 book the same way, advanced one trading day per tick (rule strategies via tick.py / bot/engine.py; agents via run_agents.py / bot/paper.py), 5 bps slippage, −15% stop. Young — it grows one session per tick.

sources.name: Backtest reference
sources.detail: A separate Dec–Jun walk-forward backtest (2026-01-02–2026-09-03, in-sample, mostly-bull) is shown inside each rule strategy's detail for context only — it is NOT the live board.

sources.name: Research analyst
sources.detail: Agent-driven on the Claude Code plan: web_search + Robinhood data → one report (state/analyst.json) with target weights per tick. Sources link from each evidence row.

sources.name: Swarm vote
sources.detail: Independent-voter election: 150 unique-profile cheap models (DeepSeek/Gemini/Llama/Haiku via OpenRouter) each read one shared briefing and return a single ballot; tallied in bot/swarm.py. No interaction between fish.

sources.name: Real-MiroFish swarm
sources.detail: Social-simulation swarm (bot/mirofish.py): persona agents with memory interact over multiple rounds — each re-ranks its best ideas seeing its own prior view and its neighbours' latest — so a consensus forms via peer influence (the opposite of the independent swarm). The panel's rank-weighted (Borda) consensus becomes a multi-name book (top 5 names, weight ∝ points). Tiered cost (cheap/default/qwen); seeded from the briefing + optional world-events news.

sources.name: Live account
sources.detail: Robinhood MCP, Agentic cash account ••••, via get_portfolio / get_equity_positions / get_equity_orders.

sources.name: Display scale
sources.detail: The real paper books are $100 each; every dollar and share figure on this site is shown ×100 (a $10,000 book) so holdings read in whole shares and dollars. Per-share prices and percentages are unscaled.

sources.name: Luck baseline
sources.detail: 200 seeded random 5-name equal-weight buy-and-hold portfolios from the same universe, same sessions — the shaded band on the chart is their 10th–90th percentile. A strategy that never leaves the band hasn't shown anything luck can't.

sources.name: Graduation bar
sources.detail: The standing rule before any strategy earns real money at scale: ≥60 forward sessions, ≥20 decisions, max drawdown better than −20%, and positive excess return vs S&P 500. Tracked live on this board.
